play_status.rollout_note: First segment validity only; reset rows use pre-reset terminal snapshots

provenance.gait_goal: Gallop-style: relaxed foot order, required forelimb participation and suspension
provenance.speed_increase_rule: Complete-cohort success controls nine speed/distance stages; no time-only promotion

startup_controller.metrics: full Gallop only, after per-episode metric warmup
startup_controller.command_progress: elapsed blend-stage time, independent of policy mixture
startup_controller.blend_progress: pose/height/angular/lateral guard, independent of speed error

posture_design.heading_observation: append sin(target-yaw), cos(target-yaw)-1 after gait phase
posture_design.yaw_penalty: wrapped absolute world heading error squared
posture_design.roll_pitch_reward: positive temporal quiet score multiplied by soft pose quality
posture_design.width_reward: independent positive 1/(1+normalized_error^2), support weight 1 and configured air weight
posture_design.direction_reward: actual world velocity projected onto target heading, with speed and travel-angle scores; no stationary credit
posture_design.stages: all phases, no gait strength or full-Gallop mask

leap_measurement.position: first all-off body pose to first touchdown; projected onto takeoff forward heading
leap_measurement.target_rule: Per-environment staged distance, independent of speed after reaching3m/s

flight_design.distance_reward_confirmation: continuous stable supported recovery after actual flight
flight_design.force_normalization: sum of positive vertical foot force / measured robot weight

stabilization_design.target_update: latch both speed and leap on environment reset; never change an ongoing episode
stabilization_design.promotion: full gait gates plus pose/support width/landing/distance; >=128 episodes, >=80% for two windows
stabilization_design.regression: below 50% at raised cap, return one speed step
stabilization_design.pose_reward: positive quiet score multiplied by soft pose quality
stabilization_design.calf_control: student only, smoothly 1.0 to 0.85 with startup blend; frozen teacher unchanged
stabilization_design.target_excess: pre-clip target excess Huber, calf weight x2

guarded_design.action_semantics: legacy default + 0.5 * mixed delta; student calf multiplier retained
guarded_design.physical_limit_write: Isaac articulation write_joint_position_limit_to_sim; soft factor 1 prevents double shrink
guarded_design.actual_limit_monitor: Measured excess penalty plus sustained violation termination; never overwrite actual positions

staged_design.evaluation: One completed episode per environment per cohort; all environments and >=128 episodes; >=80% two consecutive windows
staged_design.regression: Two complete cohorts below50% core safety/landing success regress; final style failures alone retain final-stage refinement
staged_design.targets: Per-environment speed, distance, touchdown/duty and flight timing/scales latch only on reset
staged_design.success: success is active-stage progress; staged_strict_success retains original strict criteria; staged_final_success requires final80cm strict success

quality_gates.width_and_foot_height: Rewarded throughout; mandatory only for final80cm certification

staged_design.always_required: Survival, full student measurement, tracking, contact, suspension, forelimb use, ROM, active distance, raw request cap and measured joint limits

rollout.note: Only first contiguous segment is analyzed; reset rows are pre-reset snapshots. Steady metrics exclude warmup. Runtime episode velocity sums precede interval events, whereas saved snapshots follow them.

caveats: Training criterion rates are not independent evaluation success rates.
stable combines timeout/survival, attitude and target-clipping gates; it does not mean falls alone.
Runtime flight_fraction counts cycles with sufficient air, not fraction of time airborne.
Target clipping is target-angle saturation, not actual joint-limit violation.
Reported joint excursions are per imposed phase cycle, not independently classified gait strides.
Original physics/noise/pushes remain active in play. No additional simulation or training was performed.
Leap target is latched per episode; final leap_min_distance is not the target for every training episode.

completion_evidence.note: Mean reward/episode length may omit early iterations with no completed episodes; loss steps and checkpoint counters establish completion.

reward_scalar_coverage.note: Completed-episode means may be absent before the first finished episode; absent early reward entries do not imply missing PPO updates.
